connection.UWRyYW50RGF0YVByb3ZpZGVy.sche.source: A connection to a Qdrant vector database server
connection.UWRyYW50RGF0YVByb3ZpZGVy.sche.message: 連線至 Qdrant 向量資料庫伺服器

connection.UWRyYW50RGF0YVByb3ZpZGVy.sche.source: The API key for authenticating with the Qdrant server; sent as the `api-key` header
connection.UWRyYW50RGF0YVByb3ZpZGVy.sche.message: 用於向 Qdrant 伺服器驗證的 API 金鑰；以 `api-key` 標頭傳送

connection.UWRyYW50RGF0YVByb3ZpZGVy.sche.source: The Qdrant API key for authentication
connection.UWRyYW50RGF0YVByb3ZpZGVy.sche.message: 用於驗證的 Qdrant API 金鑰

connection.UWRyYW50RGF0YVByb3ZpZGVy.sche.source: HTTP headers to send with ping requests; defaults to `{"Connection": "close"}` to force a fresh TCP connection on each ping, preventing stale keep-alive connection failures against qdrant's actix-web server (which closes idle keep-alive connections after a short timeout)
connection.UWRyYW50RGF0YVByb3ZpZGVy.sche.message: 傳送 ping 請求時使用的 HTTP 標頭；預設為 `{"Connection": "close"}`，以強制每次 ping 都建立新的 TCP 連線，防止因 qdrant 的 actix-web 伺服器（在短時間閒置後關閉保持連線）造成的閒置保持連線失敗

connection.UWRyYW50RGF0YVByb3ZpZGVy.sche.source: The URI path to use for pings; defaults to `/collections`, which requires authentication and therefore verifies the credential as well as reachability.  Do not use `/`: qdrant serves the root path outside its authentication layer, so a ping against it succeeds even when the connection carries no credential at all and no real operation can be performed
connection.UWRyYW50RGF0YVByb3ZpZGVy.sche.message: 用於 ping 的 URI 路徑；預設為 `/collections`，此路徑需要驗證憑證，因此可同時驗證憑證與連線可達性。請勿使用 `/`：Qdrant 在認證層之外提供根路徑，因此即使連線未攜帶憑證，ping 仍會成功，且無法執行任何實際操作
